findings.description: Uses .lower() instead of the spec-mandated .casefold(), which fails to perform full Unicode case folding.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md requires 'name.casefold() == stripped_query.casefold()'. candidate.py lines 2 and 4 apply .lower() instead. For instance, with users=['ß'] and query='ss', the spec expects a match because 'ß'.casefold() == 'ss'. The candidate computes 'ß'.lower() == 'ß' and query.strip().lower() == 'ss', causing a false negative.

review.summary: The candidate uses .lower() for case-insensitive matching instead of the required .casefold(), violating the full Unicode case folding specification.
